methodology_note: Round 1's `agree` column (annotation/iaa/iaa_60item_sample.csv) is frozen prior work that does not exactly reproduce under scripts/evaluate.py::score_answer alone (46/60=76.7% under the plain four-stage scorer vs. the published 85.0%): round 1 additionally applied scripts/fix_num_iaa.py, a NUM-specific regex normalizer, on top of the base scorer. Rounds 2 and 3 (this script) are scored with the plain four-stage scorer only, with no post-hoc normalization pass. The pooled 180-item figure below therefore combines two passes that are close but not identical in method; this is disclosed rather than papered over, consistent with how this paper treats scoring-rule sensitivity everywhere else.
